channel.title: Deepankar Bhadrasen — Project write-ups
channel.description: Case studies in AI automation for sales, finance and operations.

item.title: Automated Sales Pipeline
item.description: How I built a sales pipeline with n8n, OpenAI, Salesforce and Supabase to qualify leads, sequence follow-ups and keep CRM records in sync for a nonprofit.

item.title: Call Grading System
item.description: A case study in automating sales and support call reviews with OpenAI, n8n and Supabase: transcripts, custom scoring rubrics and coaching signals for teams.

item.title: Invoice Parsing System
item.description: How I built an invoice processing workflow using OpenAI, MongoDB and n8n to extract fields, validate them against orders and store structured business data.

item.title: Finance Document Agent
item.description: Inside a finance document agent using Gemini, Pinecone, OpenAI and Supabase to retrieve financial information and prepare structured loan application data.
